text:
jin: Heads-up — noticed a regression after the kernel-routing PR landed. Small-chat workloads are hitting transient OOMs on p4d when KV cache is warm and batching spikes. Profiling attached below.

maya: Ack. Which knobs did you try so far?

jin: Quick summary from a 512-token chat session with 8-concurrent streams (batching enabled). Memory spike coincides with kernel switch from fused-attn->fallback conv path.

sam: Any logs or perf counters? Can we repro locally with debug alloc tracing?

jin: Pasted a trimmed profiler snippet (nvprof-like):

```
GPU mem before requests: 6.2GB
concurrent batches ramp: +1.2GB
kv-cache warmup (reserve): +800MB
attn kernel switch: +1.6GB
Peak resident: 9.8GB -> OOM on some pods
```

jin: Quick knobs I toggled manually on one replica:
- expandable_segments: false -> prevented a couple of OOMs but increased fragmentation
- max_split_size_mb: 128 -> 64 reduced peak in one run
- garbage_collection_threshold: 0.7 -> 0.85 made no visible difference

maya: Interesting. So expandable_segments false reduces growth but fragments. We need safe defaults for hosted. Any idea why kernel switch changes allocator behavior so much?

sam: My theory: the fused kernel path uses different workspace layout, smaller temp allocations but larger lifetime overlap; fallback path uses many short-lived allocations that the PyTorch/CUDA allocator handles poorly with current split/gc settings. That increases external fragmentation.

jin: Repro steps I used (very compact):
```
export RW_BATCHING=auto
export RW_KV_WARMUP=true
python stress_chat.py --model gpt-like --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --kernel-mode staged
```

lina-bot: deploy-bot noticed 4 pod restarts in us-west cluster between 11:02-11:08, linked to oom-kill events.

depploy-bot: rollback of the kernel-routing change was triggered on a canary cluster at 11:15.

maya: Actionable plan:
1) Run allocator live-profiling (alloc-trace) for both kernel variants and capture split/segment allocations.
2) Sweep tests for max_split_size_mb in [32,64,128,256] with expandable_segments on/off.
3) Adjust garbage_collection_threshold and measure fragmentation metrics.

sam: I can set up the alloc-trace and synthetic runner. Will add a micro-benchmark that toggles KV cache pressure precisely.

jin: Also propose a mitigation we can roll quickly for hosted: when kernel falls back, temporarily tighten max_split_size_mb to 64 and force a GC pass after KV warmup. Quick patch below (pseudo-config):

```
runtime.defaults.max_split_size_mb = 64
runtime.gc.force_after_kv_warmup = true
```

maya: Good. Rollout plan: feature-flag the change on Dedicated/Hosted canaries only. If it reduces OOMs and latency stays within SLO, promote.

sam: I'll post repro artifacts and a short script (alloc-trace + flamegraph) in this thread when ready.

jin: Great. For tracking: created PERF-1582 to capture experiments + threshold numbers. Assigning sam + maya. I'll follow up with raw nvprof traces and a couple flamegraphs.

maya: Thanks — let's sync after the first 4 sweep runs. :thumbsup!
